[[File:Calder.decipher.com 5 December 1998.jpg|thumb|calder.decipher.com default page, 5 December 1998.]]
[[File:Calder.decipher.com Star Wars CCG March 2000.jpg|thumb|Star Wars CCG section on calder, March 2000.]]
'''calder.decipher.com''' was a [[Decipher.com]] host. It ran CGI programs, including the message boards and the e-card maker, and is the largest host in the Internet Archive's Decipher set, with about 65,000 URLs.<ref name="calder">[http://calder.decipher.com/ Enterprise Home Page], Decipher (December 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19981205175446/http://calder.decipher.com/ Internet Archive]</ref> The host's web root in December 1998 still showed Netscape Enterprise Server's default home page. By 2000 the ''Star Wars CCG'' section, including card lists, rules and tournaments, was served from this host.<ref name="sw">[http://calder.decipher.com/starwars/index.html Star Wars CCG], Decipher (March 2000). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000302135655/http://calder.decipher.com/starwars/index.html Internet Archive]</ref> The Mara Jade promotion under <code>/marajade/</code> also ran here.<ref>[http://calder.decipher.com/marajade/index.html Decipher Presents Mara Jade!], Decipher (2000). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001023003214/http://calder.decipher.com/marajade/index.html Internet Archive]</ref>
